name: Taira no Norimori
source:
Taira no Norimori is a military commander of the Heike clan. He is the half-brother of Kiyomori  and the father of Noritsune. He is a cool, calm, and strict man. He has a sharp and intimidating look in his eyes.

The timid Munemori seems to be a bit intimidated by him.
